subtasks.description: Inspect channel metadata, duplicated/silent channels, sample rate and trusted PBX channel-to-role mapping.
Create channel-preserving normalized derivatives, VAD intervals and reversible original-time mapping.
Implement selected Whisper model profiles and language policy; compare base versus stronger multilingual candidates.
Add long-call chunking/checkpoints, overlap deduplication and no-speech handling.
Move model lifetime to persistent warmed worker processes with memory-aware concurrency and bounded batching.
Add CPU/GPU readiness/preflight and route work only to qualified workers.
Measure Persian/English/mixed and noisy/stereo/mono accuracy, latency, GPU memory and actual cost under admitted load.
